findings.problem: möchten has no Perfekt of its own: hat gemocht is the Perfekt of mögen and means liked, not wanted, so a learner who memorizes it would say the wrong thing; a past wish uses wollen (hat gewollt, wollte).
findings.fix: grammar.perfekt: null (or note that the past is expressed with wollen: hat gewollt)

back.example: He would like a coffee, please.

note: The hint "polite wish" is fine; it steers away from "er will" (he wants), and only "er möchte" fits the möchten strip.
